Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “where Robert Khayat was educated” as the specific sub-school (University of Mississippi School of Law) and introduced Cleve McDowell (1963) as the first Black student there, instead of recognizing the broader institution (University of Mississippi/Ole Miss) where the correct answer is James Howard Meredith (1962). This incorrect reframing would lead to the wrong solution.
